summary: Google DeepMind, together with Schmidt Sciences, the Cooperative AI Foundation, ARIA and Google.org, announced a technical research funding call of up to $10M for academic and independent researchers to study safety in large-scale multi-agent AI systems.

practices.reason: The funding call names sandboxes/testbeds and oversight-and-control as priority research areas for measuring multi-agent safety, but these are proposal topics for future grantees rather than a method delivered today.
practices.quote: Sandboxes and testbeds: Building realistic, reproducible environments to evaluate, compare and accelerate progress across all areas of multi-agent safety.
